summary: Defines the inter-agent conflict-resolution protocol (classification order definitional -> vintage -> coverage -> methodological; keep both values; default model input chosen only as a labelled assumption) and pre-registers 18 likely conflicts to watch, including NSO fiscal-year vs WDI/WEO year-labelled GDP (C-01), USD conversion conventions (C-02), NRB workers' remittances vs BPM6 personal remittances (C-05), and Census 2021 vs UN WPP population (C-06). No actual conflicts can be detected in r1: the observation store is empty. One structural escalation to a human reviewer is open (ESC-01, catalog dependencies delaying the US$3T arithmetic), one to 00A (hosts unreachable), and two human escalations are pre-registered for the USD conversion convention and population concept.

findings.claim: Which agents report conflicting values for the same variable and period: none can be identified in r1 because the observation store is empty (research/sources/observations.jsonl absent) and no other findings exist.
findings.note: Required: retrieved observations from P2-01..P2-07 (00A-r1) and upstream findings; run find_conflicts in r2.

findings.claim: Eighteen likely conflict areas are pre-registered (C-01..C-18) with anticipated classification; classifications are hypotheses to be confirmed against retrieved source metadata.
Conflict classification follows a fixed order — definitional, vintage, coverage, then methodological — so that only residuals unexplained by the first three are treated as methodological disputes.

Disputes requiring a human reviewer now: ESC-01 (catalog dependency structure delaying the US$3T arithmetic). Pre-registered for possible human escalation: ESC-03 (USD conversion convention), ESC-04 (population concept).
findings.note: Based on platform records (config/subagents.json, state/plan.md); no empirical values.

findings.claim: Audit ledger state: all 22 entries (TGT-ARITH-001 and SCN-S01..S10 by auditors 15 and 28) are UNVERIFIED with pending-input reasons; no auditor dispute exists yet to coordinate.
findings.note: Read from reports/audits/audit_ledger.jsonl (platform record, not an economic observation); reproduced by reference, not paraphrased.

data_gaps: research/sources/observations.jsonl does not exist; find_conflicts has nothing to compare.
WDI country metadata for Nepal (national-accounts reference period and FY label mapping) — needed for C-01.
IMF WEO country notes for Nepal (fiscal-year treatment, estimates-start year per vintage) — C-01..C-03.
NRB BoP compilation notes (BPM edition, remittance item definitions) — C-05.
Census 2021 enumeration concept and absentee treatment; WPP methodology note for Nepal — C-06.
PDMO and IMF debt coverage definitions — C-08, C-09.

assumptions.text: The conflict tolerance is tolerances.source_conflict_rel_tol in config/model_config.yaml, applied after period alignment; published-table identity residuals use tolerances.published_accounts_rel_tol.
When concepts match after alignment, the higher-tier source is the default model input, recorded as a labelled assumption citing both observation ids.
A conflict is 'closed' only when both values remain in the store and the register entry documents the bridge or the escalation outcome.

challenges.text: Adopt and register one USD conversion convention before re-running TGT-ARITH (C-02/ESC-03).
Report NRB workers' remittances and BPM6 personal remittances as separate variables; do not compare them as one (C-05).
Record census absentee treatment and WPP reference date explicitly (C-06).
State institutional coverage for every debt ratio (C-08).
Include period-basis and coverage checks from this register in statistical audits.

uncertainty: High: the register is anticipatory. Classifications are hypotheses from known definitional differences and must be confirmed against source metadata once retrieved; some expected conflicts may not materialise and others (e.g. provincial vs national series) may appear. No values have been compared, so the size of any disagreement is unknown. All lead URLs are catalog-level and unverified.

conflict_register.period_basis_issue: NSO reports Nepal fiscal years (mid-July to mid-July); WDI/WEO present annual values under a single year label. The label mapping for Nepal must be read from WDI country metadata and WEO country notes, not assumed.
conflict_register.mechanism: Apparent differences arise if one series labels FY2023/24 as 2023 and another as 2024, or if WDI/WEO carry an older NSO vintage.
investigation_steps: Pair values by the underlying FY, not by label
Record NSO release date vs WDI/WEO vintage
Recompute relative difference after alignment; residual beyond tolerances.source_conflict_rel_tol is investigated further
conflict_register.escalate_if: label mapping cannot be determined from published metadata

sources_compared: derived: NSO GDP / NRB FY-average NPR/USD
conflict_register.period_basis_issue: FY GDP converted at FY-average FX vs CY-labelled GDP converted at CY-average FX (WDI PA.NUS.FCRF) or WEO's own conversion.
conflict_register.mechanism: Differences stem from FX averaging period and from which GDP vintage each database used; not an error in either source.
investigation_steps: Reproduce each USD figure from its NPR GDP and stated FX
Document which convention the headline US$3T arithmetic uses (00A task P3-01)
conflict_register.escalate_if: the choice of convention changes the milestone year at which a scenario reaches US$3T

conflict_register.period_basis_issue: Latest FY is typically a preliminary estimate; WEO mixes outturns and projections.
conflict_register.mechanism: Revisions between NSO releases, constant-price rebasing and WEO projection years.
investigation_steps: Tag every observation with revision status
Flag WEO values after the estimates-start year as projections — never used as history (source_policy rule 6)
Compare only same-status values

conflict_register.period_basis_issue: FY averages (NSO, NRB) vs CY (WDI); NRB also publishes year-on-year mid-month rates.
conflict_register.mechanism: Deflator covers domestic output prices; CPI covers consumer basket incl. imports — different concepts, not a conflict to be resolved to one value.
investigation_steps: Never substitute CPI for the deflator in USD GDP arithmetic
Record basket base year for CPI

conflict_register.period_basis_issue: NRB FY flows over FY GDP vs WDI CY flows over CY GDP.
conflict_register.mechanism: Workers' remittances (NRB) vs personal remittances = personal transfers + compensation of employees (BPM6); informal channels excluded from both; KNOMAD bilateral figures are model-based estimates.
investigation_steps: Record NRB item definition and BPM edition
Reconcile numerator items before comparing
Use same-period denominator
conflict_register.escalate_if: numerator items cannot be reconciled from published BoP detail

conflict_register.period_basis_issue: Census reference date vs WPP mid-year (1 July) estimates.
conflict_register.mechanism: Census counts usual residents with the absent population abroad recorded separately; WPP applies demographic reconstruction and may adjust for under-enumeration; treatment of absentees may differ.
investigation_steps: Record enumeration concept and absentee treatment for each
Keep census and WPP as separate observations; choose per use (per-capita GDP vs labour supply) as a labelled assumption
conflict_register.escalate_if: absentee treatment is undocumented in either source

conflict_register.period_basis_issue: Survey rounds are years apart; ILO modelled series are annual interpolations/extrapolations.
conflict_register.mechanism: Different ICLS work/employment definitions across NLFS rounds; modelled vs survey values.
investigation_steps: Record ICLS resolution applied per round
Do not treat modelled values as observations of survey years

conflict_register.period_basis_issue: FY-end stock (PDMO) vs WEO year label; denominator GDP period.
conflict_register.mechanism: Central government vs general government; inclusion of subnational, SOE and guaranteed debt.
investigation_steps: Record institutional coverage for each
Build coverage bridge table

conflict_register.mechanism: IDS total includes private non-guaranteed debt, IMF credit and short-term debt.
investigation_steps: Compare public and publicly guaranteed component only, then report the remainder separately

conflict_register.mechanism: CIF vs FOB valuation, BoP adjustments, informal border trade, electricity trade treatment.
investigation_steps: Record valuation basis
Treat mirror gaps as evidence of coverage issues, not as corrections

conflict_register.period_basis_issue: NEA FY vs Indian April-March fiscal year.
conflict_register.mechanism: NEA-owned vs IPP purchases; gross vs net of losses; bilateral vs exchange sales.
investigation_steps: Record which generators and trade channels are included

conflict_register.period_basis_issue: Survey year(s) vs PIP reference year lining.
conflict_register.mechanism: Different poverty lines, welfare aggregates and PPP vintages.
investigation_steps: Report both; never merge

conflict_register.mechanism: Commitments/approvals are not flows; BoP flows include reinvested earnings depending on compilation.
investigation_steps: Label commitments vs realised flows separately

conflict_register.period_basis_issue: FY flows vs census stock at a reference date.
conflict_register.mechanism: Permits include renewals depending on table; India-bound migration is not permitted-based; destination counts cover nationals of Nepal by residence permit.
investigation_steps: Never compare flows with stocks
Record India-corridor coverage gap explicitly

conflict_register.mechanism: Treatment of Indian land arrivals and same-day visitors; receipts from BoP vs survey spending.
investigation_steps: Record arrival definition per source

conflict_register.period_basis_issue: Same FY but different closing dates of accounts.
conflict_register.mechanism: Denominator: original vs revised budget; inclusion of foreign-aid direct payments.
investigation_steps: State denominator explicitly

conflict_register.period_basis_issue: FY average vs CY average vs end-period.
investigation_steps: Compare like-for-like averages only

conflict_register.period_basis_issue: Period average vs end-period; FY vs CY.
investigation_steps: Record rate type and averaging method

open_and_preregistered.issue: Catalog dependencies place 01C (US$3T arithmetic) and the data-ingestion tasks of 01A/03A/10C behind the global research wave, delaying the arithmetic although its inputs are Phase-2 data (see 00A-r1 catalog_bottlenecks).

positions.keep_catalog: Full upstream context ensures interpretation is informed by global evidence before any number is produced.
positions.add_data_only_variants: Base-year ingestion and arithmetic do not use that context; gating them delays auditability without evidential benefit.

open_and_preregistered.decision_required: Whether to add data-only / arithmetic-only task variants to config/catalog.yaml.

open_and_preregistered.issue: All tier-1 and tier-2 data hosts unreachable in r1; every conflict in the register is unverifiable until leads are fetched (task P2-01).
open_and_preregistered.decision_required: Schedule r2 in a network environment permitted to reach the hosts in docs/implementation/data_access.md.

open_and_preregistered.issue: Headline USD conversion convention (C-02): FY GDP at FY-average FX vs CY-aligned series. Escalate with both positions if 01C and 15A/28E disagree or if the convention changes a milestone crossing.
open_and_preregistered.decision_required: Canonical convention for the headline target, recorded as an assumption in config/model_config.yaml.

open_and_preregistered.issue: Population concept for per-capita and labour-supply use (C-06): census usual-resident vs WPP mid-year estimate, and absentee treatment.
open_and_preregistered.decision_required: Which concept is used for which model purpose.

open_and_preregistered.issue: Any reconciliation in C-01..C-03 that changes base-year USD GDP beyond tolerance changes TGT-ARITH and all scenarios; must be re-audited.

criteria: Escalate to 00B investigation (automatic): find_conflicts reports same variable/country/period/unit values differing beyond tolerances.source_conflict_rel_tol in config/model_config.yaml.
Escalate to 00A: a source required to classify or resolve a conflict is inaccessible — item stays pending with exact data required; no estimate substituted.
Escalate to Agents 15 and 28: a resolution would change a base-year input, a strategy result or a scenario conclusion.

Escalate to a human reviewer with both positions stated when: (a) the classification remains 'methodological' after definitions, period, vintage and coverage are aligned and the residual still exceeds tolerance; (b) two tier-equal sources disagree and the choice changes a headline result (e.g. milestone year); (c) agents disagree on the canonical convention after one challenge round; (d) resolving the dispute would require an action outside the repository (e.g. contacting a statistics office).
Never escalate by picking a value: both observations are kept; the chosen model input is recorded as a labelled assumption citing both observation ids.

classification_order.test: Do the two values measure the same concept (item definition, price basis, currency, reference period type: FY vs CY, average vs end-period)? If not, the difference is definitional: record both, build a bridge if published detail allows, do not reconcile to one value.

Same concept but different release/revision status or base year? Compare publication dates and revision labels; the later official vintage of the same concept supersedes only by explicit status 'superseded', never by deletion.
Same concept and vintage but different institutional, geographic or population coverage? Record coverage of each and a bridge table.
Residual after steps 1-3 exceeds tolerance: differing estimation method (modelled vs survey, PPP method, imputation). Document both methods; escalate per criteria if unresolved.

protocol.records: Each conflict gets a register entry with both observation ids, data vintages, classification, bridge or residual, and status: open / explained / escalated / closed.
protocol.source_hierarchy_use: Hierarchy (CLAUDE.md rule 5) selects the default model input only when concepts match after step 1; it never deletes the other value.
protocol.fy_cy_rule: No FY/CY mixing without a documented conversion registered as an assumption (CLAUDE.md rule 6); unconverted pairs are compared by underlying period only.
protocol.projection_rule: Values past a database's estimates-start year are projections and excluded from historical comparison.

resolution_notes.r1_status: pending — no observations retrieved; protocol and watch-list defined. In r2 run find_conflicts on the store and populate observation_ids and values fields of matching register entries; new conflicts get ids C-19 onward.
